adminUsers.intro: Everyone who signs up is a User (can create quizzes, host rooms, play). Players join by PIN with no account. What an admin manages is the license plan (Free/Pro) and optionally granting system admin.

adminLicense.title: License management
adminLicense.roleNote: Admin role ≠ Pro plan. Subscriptions tab:
adminLicense.name: Name
adminLicense.mintTitle: Mint a batch of activation codes
adminLicense.appendOnlyNote: This table is append-only. A correction is a new row, never an edit of the old one.
adminLicense.revokeProTitle: Revoke Pro, back to Free now
adminLicense.enforcementOffNote: Enforcement is OFF — every host is unlocked, plans gate nothing.
adminLicense.roleNoteRich: Admin role ≠ Pro plan. Subscriptions tab: Grant Pro or Revoke Pro (back to Free immediately).
adminLicense.enforcementOffBody: Enforcement is OFF — every host is unlocked, plans gate nothing.
adminLicense.recordedNote: This is what the system recorded, not what the bank received.
adminLicense.roleNoteFull: Admin role ≠ Pro plan. Subscriptions tab: Grant Pro or Revoke Pro (back to Free immediately). Players join by PIN and need no account.
adminLicense.enforcementOnFull: Enforcement is ON. Accounts on the free plan cannot create quizzes or rooms — unlock them with an activation code, or assign a plan in the User licenses tab.
adminLicense.enforcementOffFull: Enforcement is OFF — every host is unlocked and plans gate nothing. Turn it on with the switch on this page; no backend restart needed.
adminLicense.recordedNoteFull: This is what the system recorded, not what the bank received. Payments run through a third party, not through the app. Reconcile this column against your statement — the gap is the thing to look for.
adminLicense.amountRefNote: The amount and payment reference travel with the activation code, and on into the history once a buyer redeems it. They are the only link between a granted plan and money received through a third party — leave them blank and you cannot reconcile later.
adminLicense.revokeNote: Two levels: Revoke (ban icon) only blocks new redemptions and leaves granted plans alone. Claw back (arrow icon) takes the plan back from everyone who used the code and ends their live rooms — except anyone granted a different plan since.
adminLicense.sendBatchNote: Sends all {count} codes in one email. The sent column is only marked once SMTP accepts the message.
adminLicense.justMinted: {count} codes just minted — copy and store them now
adminLicense.alreadyFree: This user is already on Free — nothing to revoke
adminLicense.clipboardBlocked: The browser blocked the clipboard — select the text and copy it manually
adminLicense.confirmRevoke:
Revoke the Pro license for {label}?
They drop to the Free plan immediately.
adminLicense.enforcementEnvPinned: Pinned by the LICENSE_ENFORCEMENT environment variable — this switch is read-only. Remove that variable and restart the backend to use it again.
adminLicense.confirmEnforcementOn: Turn enforcement on? {hosts} active host(s) are still on the free plan and will be blocked from creating quizzes and rooms immediately.
adminLicense.confirmEnforcementOff: Turn enforcement off? Every host becomes fully unlocked and no plan gates anything.
adminLicense.confirmEnforcementForce: Ignore {count} unmet condition(s) and turn enforcement on?
adminLicense.readinessFreePlanLocked: Free plan is locked down (all limits 0)
adminLicense.readinessFreePlanOpen: Free plan is still permissive — run 01_lock_free_plan.sql
adminLicense.readinessAdminsOk: Every admin is on a paid plan
adminLicense.readinessHostsOk: Every active host has a plan
adminLicense.readinessHostsOnFree: {count} of {total} active hosts are still on free
adminLicense.readinessLiveRooms: {count} open room(s) will stop admitting new players
adminLicense.readinessGrandfatherMissing: subscription_events is empty — 02_grandfather_hosts.sql may not have run
